config.title: Markdown AI Translator
config.apiBaseUrl: OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions base URL. Set in User Settings. Use HTTPS for remote servers or HTTP for loopback only. API keys are stored per endpoint.
config.model: Model name to use, e.g. `gpt-4o-mini` or `deepseek-chat`.
config.sourceLanguage: Source language. Use `auto` for auto detection, or a language name such as `English`.
config.targetLanguage: Target language, e.g. `简体中文` or `English`.
config.systemPrompt: System prompt used for translation. The placeholders `{sourceLanguage}` and `{targetLanguage}` are replaced with the configured languages.
config.temperature: Sampling temperature passed to the model.
config.translationMode: Default display mode of the translation preview.
config.translationMode.bilingual: Show the source text with the translation below each block.
config.requestTimeout: Timeout in milliseconds for each API request.
config.maxConcurrency: Maximum concurrent requests within one document translation.
config.maxTokensPerRequest: Approximate maximum number of tokens sent per API request. Larger documents are split into multiple requests.
config.maxRetries: Number of retries for failed or invalid API responses (exponential backoff).
config.cacheEnabled: Cache translation results locally to avoid repeated API calls for unchanged text.
config.cacheTtlDays: How many days cached translations are kept.
